theater: 雅典、阿提卡與比奧提亞

battle.name: 維奧蒂亞戰爭
battle.theater: 雅典、阿提卡與比奧提亞
battle.brief: 公元前378年，斯巴達為拆散維奧蒂亞聯盟，國王克里奧布羅圖斯一世率軍進入阿提卡，直逼雅典城牆。底比斯聯軍退守基泰戎山口，騎兵擊潰斯巴達前哨，斐里堡守軍逼退呂山德夜襲。海線上卡布里亞斯的六十艘戰船拖住斯巴達，前376年尼亞克索斯海戰扭轉乾坤。卡面埃及長矛代表更古老的東方長矛傳統。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 公元前378年開打的不是兩個國家，而是兩個聯盟的正面對撞。斯巴達一方是以拉科尼亞的斯巴達城邦為首的伯羅奔尼撒聯盟：主權分屬兩支王族，國王之下設五名監察官與長老會議，能提出解散聯盟議案的正是監察官；公民按共膳班編為伍，成年男子受國家教養制度訓練，戰時抽編重裝步兵，盟邦則要交出分遣隊或繳納貢賦，聯軍由斯巴達將軍統率。維奧蒂亞一方是底比斯主導的維奧蒂亞聯盟：十一人議事會代表各城，設四名輪任的聯盟執政官，主要城邦各出重裝步兵與騎兵，底比斯另有三百人的聖隊與一批受過城防訓練的年輕軍官。開戰時聯盟拉上雅典；雅典寧可與斯巴達短暫合作，也不願看著底比斯壟斷維奧蒂亞，並且以三列槳戰船和登船水兵作戰，補給線比任何城邦都拉得更長。外圍還有福基斯、第二次神聖戰爭的另一方，以及阿爾戈斯與塞薩利；波斯王阿爾塔薛西斯二世和塞浦路斯、埃及的宮廷提供金錢與穀物。性質上，這是一場希臘城邦世界裡的內戰，勝負不取決於一城獨力承擔，而取決於哪些城肯把自己的重裝步兵交出來。
countriesEn: What began in 378 BC was not a clash between two states but between two alliances. On the Spartan side stood the Peloponnesian League led by the city-state of Sparta in Laconia. Sovereign power was shared by two royal houses, with five ephors and a council of elders beneath the kings, and it was the ephors who could bring forward a decree dissolving the leagues. Citizens were enrolled in messes, the men of military age were trained under the Spartan system of upbringing, and in wartime they were mustered as hoplites; the allied cities either supplied contingents or paid tribute, and the federal army was led by Spartan generals. The other side was the Boeotian League led by Thebes: a council of eleven represented the member cities, four boeotarchs rotated in turn as league commanders, and the principal cities contributed hoplites and cavalry, while Thebes itself maintained the three hundred-strong Sacred Band and a body of young officers trained in the city's garrison service. Athens was drawn into that coalition at the outset, preferring a short alignment with Sparta to a Boeotian monopoly over Boeotia, and it fought with triremes and marines, its supply line reaching further by sea than that of any other city-state. Around them stood Phocis, the other party of the Second Sacred War, together with Argos and Thessaly, while King Artaxerxes II of Persia and the courts of Cyprus and Egypt supplied money and grain. In nature this was a civil war inside the Greek world of city-states, and the outcome was not decided by any single city but by which cities were willing to hand over their hoplites.
people: 斯巴達方面，國王克里奧布羅圖斯一世率領入侵軍進入阿提卡，兵鋒直指雅典城牆；但他並不是主謀，真正的推手是監察官陣營中反對波斯介入的那一派。維奧蒂亞一方，底比斯的艾吉亞斯率聯盟騎兵在基泰戎山口擊潰斯巴達前哨，是這場戰爭第一次硬碰硬的場面；三百名底比斯流亡者退守斐里堡，由雅典將軍卡布里亞斯訓練與指揮，擊退斯巴達將領呂山德的夜襲。海權方面，卡布里亞斯的艦隊在尼亞克索斯逼退斯巴達，雅典使節提摩太等人隨即以海權為籌碼，在和談中取得斯巴達的讓步。福基斯的菲利梅洛斯奪取德爾菲，把第二次神聖戰爭拖進戰局，令斯巴達與底比斯之間的矛盾再無從迴避。波斯王阿爾塔薛西斯二世以所謂波斯書信命令沿海總督把斯巴達人逐出亞洲，同時以津貼支撐聯盟一方；埃及法老涅克塔內沃二世在西部地中海的處境，也直接影響到聯盟的財政。
peopleEn: For Sparta, King Cleombrotus I led the invading army into Attica and brought it up against the walls of Athens, but he was not the mover: the true driving force was the party among the ephors that opposed Persian interference. On the Boeotian side, Aegias of Thebes led the league cavalry and broke the Spartan outpost at the Cithaeron passes, the first set-piece collision of the campaign. Three hundred Theban exiles, shut up in the fort of Phyle, were drilled and commanded by the Athenian general Chabrias and turned back the night raid of the Spartan commander Lysander. At sea, Chabrias' fleet forced the Spartans back off Naxos, and the Athenian envoys led by Timotheus at once turned that command of the sea into bargaining power and extracted concessions from Sparta at the peace talks. On the Phocian side, the seizure of Delphi by Philomelus dragged the Second Sacred War into the conflict, leaving neither Sparta nor Thebes a way out. King Artaxerxes II of Persia, through the so-called Persian Letters, ordered his satraps along the coast to drive the Spartans out of Asia while at the same time subsidising the coalition, and the position of Pharaoh Nectanebo II in the western Mediterranean likewise shaped the finances of the league.
kits: 卡面的埃及長矛是早王朝時期（公元前三千二百年前後）的銅矛：矛頭仍以綁縛或鉚釘固定在木杆上，還不是後來希臘人使用的套筒式矛頭。這種樣式在早王朝埃及主要用於守衛城垣、護衛隊列與清剿野生動物，埃及人把它配在木盾與短柄石斧之間使用。值得說明的是血脈的流向：銅矛技術經埃及、西奈、迦南、腓尼基一路傳到愛琴海，落到前四世紀希臘人手上時已變成多利亞矛，鐵或青銅矛頭套在白蠻木杆上，長約兩米，握在後三分之一處，與直徑約六十至九十厘米的圓盾並肩。前四世紀重裝步兵的標準裝備是科林斯式青銅盔或較輕的敞面盔、亞麻布或青銅片胸甲、護脛與膝甲、短柄劍，加上每人一支矛。斯巴達另有皮爾塔斯特使用輕矛、投石索與短彎刀；海軍方面雙方都靠三列槳戰船、登船用的攻城板與撞角。攻城器械方面，斯巴達在科林斯戰爭已用過撞槌與破城槌，這次圍攻斐里同樣派出工程兵。真正承載戰爭的物資是糧食：行軍中的希臘重裝步兵每日每人要食大約一夸特穀物，折合今式一公升多；斯巴達靠盟邦分擔，雅典靠海上貿易與友邦供應，維奧蒂亞聯盟則靠比奧提亞平原的穀物與山城。
kitsEn: The card's Egyptian spear is a piece from the Early Dynastic period, around 3200 BC: the head is still fixed to a wooden shaft by binding or rivets, not by the socketed form used by later Greeks. This type was used in Early Dynastic Egypt mainly to hold city walls, to escort columns and to clear wild animals, and the Egyptians matched it with wooden shields and short-handled axes. The line of descent is worth tracing: the copper-spear technology passed from Egypt through Sinai, Canaan and Phoenicia to the Aegean, and by the fourth century BC it had become the Greek dory, an iron or bronze socketed head on an ash shaft about two metres long, gripped at the rear third and carried alongside the aspis, a round shield between sixty and ninety centimetres across. The standard kit of a hoplite in that century comprised a Corinthian bronze helmet or the lighter open-faced type, a linen or bronze-plate corselet, greaves and knee guards, a short sword, and one spear to the man. The Spartans added peltasts with lighter spears, slings and short curved swords, while at sea both sides relied on triremes fitted with boarding bridges and rams. On the siege side Sparta had already used battering rams and stone-throwing engines in the Corinthian War, and it sent engineers against Phyle as well. The material base that actually carried the campaign was grain: a Greek hoplite ate roughly a quart of grain a day on the march, a little over a litre in modern measure. Sparta met that burden through allied contributions, Athens through seaborne trade and its allies, and the Boeotian League through the grain of the Boeotian plain and its upland towns.
tactics: 斯巴達的第一步不是打仗而是拆台：監察官要求各城召回派往聯軍的分遣隊，等於用一道行政命令同時解散維奧蒂亞聯盟與雅典的海上同盟。底比斯拒絕，斯巴達便以克里奧布羅圖斯為首進入阿提卡，打算用兵臨城下的辦法令雅典與聯盟屈服。戰術上斯巴達仍然用自己最熟的方陣，靠密集縱深、短兵相接與體力壓人；但在基泰戎山口，聯軍不在平原展開，而是利用山勢把斯巴達擋在狹窄通道，再由底比斯騎兵自側翼衝鋒，擊散斯巴達前哨，俘虜了一批斯巴達公民兵。斐里堡一役是守城戰的樣板：底比斯流亡者利用高地堡壘、夜間出擊與地形，加以斯巴達攻方的輕率，逼得呂山德受傷退去。海戰方面，色諾芬記載卡布里亞斯在尼亞克索斯不准水兵從高舷俯衝，而命人以盾護住船舷、貼住敵船纏鬥，用防禦姿態換取斯巴達水兵在體力與站位上的劣勢，最後由雅典的划槳速度決定勝負。
tacticsEn: Sparta's first move was not a battle but a demolition: the ephors called on every city to recall the contingents it had sent to the federal armies, an administrative stroke that dissolved the Boeotian League and the Athenian maritime alliance at one blow. Thebes refused, so Cleombrotus marched into Attica in the hope that an army appearing before the walls would bring Athens and the league to terms. Tactically Sparta still relied on the formation it knew best, a dense phalanx fought at close quarters with weight and endurance on its side. At the Cithaeron passes, however, the confederates did not deploy on open ground: they used the hills to pin the Spartans in a narrow defile, and Theban cavalry then charged from the flank, scattering the Spartan outpost and taking a number of Spartan citizens prisoner. The action at Phyle was a model of fort defence, with the Theban exiles using the height of the stronghold, night sorties and the terrain, and with the over-confidence of the Spartan attackers, until Lysander withdrew wounded. At sea Xenophon records that Chabrias, off Naxos, forbade his men to charge down from the high gunwales and instead ordered them to brace their shields along the ship's side and fight at close quarters along the enemy's hull, trading an attacking posture for a defensive one that wore out the Spartan crews and left them standing badly on their own decks; the result was settled by the speed of the Athenian oars rather than by ramming.
data: 時間線：維奧蒂亞聯盟公開拒絕解散令在公元前378年，斯巴達進入阿提卡與基泰戎山區的戰事集中在同年夏天，尼亞克索斯海戰與和約落於公元前376年九月，第二次神聖戰爭則以福基斯在庫羅科斯原野的慘敗收場。編制數字：維奧蒂亞聯盟議事會由十一城的代表組成，聯盟執政官四名；底比斯聖隊三百人；斐里堡的底比斯流亡者亦約三百人；斯巴達的伯羅奔尼撒聯盟成員約三十個城邦。兵力：色諾芬記載卡布里亞斯出動六十艘三列槳戰船；狄奧多羅斯記載第二次神聖戰爭中塞薩利方面的騎兵約二千。損失：按古代記述，尼亞克索斯一役斯巴達方面損失戰船約九艘、數百人。距離：雅典至底比斯直線距離約四十公里，斐里堡在雅典西北約二十公里，基泰戎山各山口距雅典約五十至六十公里。以上數字主要依據色諾芬《希臘史》第五卷與狄奧多羅斯《歷史文庫》第十五卷；古代記載本身常有出入，實際在場兵力往往低於公佈數字。
dataEn: The chronology: the Boeotian League's open refusal of the dissolution order came in 378 BC; the fighting in Attica and in the Cithaeron hills was concentrated in the summer of the same year; the naval action off Naxos and the peace settlement that followed were closed in September 376 BC; and the Second Sacred War ended with the Phocian defeat at the Crocus Field. On organisation: the council of the Boeotian League was made up of the representatives of eleven cities, and it had four rotating boeotarchs; the Theban Sacred Band numbered three hundred, and the Theban exiles holding Phyle were about three hundred as well; the Peloponnesian League under Sparta counted roughly thirty member states. On forces: Xenophon records Chabrias taking sixty triremes out, and Diodorus puts the Thessalian cavalry in the Second Sacred War at about two thousand. On losses: the ancient accounts put the Spartan cost at Naxos at about nine ships and several hundred men. On distances: Thebes lies roughly forty kilometres from Athens in a straight line, the fort of Phyle stands about twenty kilometres north-west of Athens, and the passes of Cithaeron are some fifty to sixty kilometres from the city. These figures rest chiefly on book five of Xenophon's Hellenica and book fifteen of the Library of History of Diodorus; the ancient records are themselves inconsistent, and the strength actually present in the field was often below the number officially announced.
cause: 打起來有三層原因。第一層是斯巴達要拆聯盟：伯羅奔尼撒戰爭之後，斯巴達靠波斯認可的王和平維持霸主地位，但維奧蒂亞聯盟與雅典第二同盟越來越能夠自力維持，拆掉聯盟就是對付這兩股力量的辦法。第二層是聯盟內部的結構矛盾：維奧蒂亞聯盟的分遣隊制度要求各城出錢出兵，斯巴達一句召回自己人，等於取消每一座城的自保能力，對底比斯而言無異於解散聯盟，因此拒絕得又快又硬。第三層是外患把兩個陣營綁在一起：福基斯為德爾菲的宗教權利向底比斯開火，引發第二次神聖戰爭；斯巴達若不出手，盟邦便會轉向底比斯，於是雅典與底比斯以戰爭回應，希臘城邦世界的內戰便從聯盟對聯盟的形式爆發出來。底下還有一層經濟原因：斯巴達的財政長期靠盟邦貢賦與黑海沿岸的穀物貿易，戰事一開，貢賦斷流，戰時稅一開，聯盟內部關於分配與負擔的矛盾便浮到水面。
causeEn: There were three layers behind the fighting. The first was Sparta's determination to break up the alliances: after the Peloponnesian War, Spartan supremacy rested on a King's Peace recognised by Persia, but the Boeotian League and the Second Athenian League were increasingly able to sustain themselves, and dissolving the leagues was the way to deal with both. The second was the structural contradiction inside the league system: the Boeotian League required each member city to supply men and money for a federal army, and a Spartan order to call those men home cancelled the self-defence of every member city, so for Thebes it was tantamount to a decree of dissolution, and the refusal was quick and hard. The third was that outside pressure bound the two camps together. Phocis lit the Second Sacred War over the religious authority of Delphi and against Thebes; if Sparta did not act, the member states would drift toward Thebes, so Athens and Thebes answered with war, and a civil war inside the Greek world of city-states took the form of one alliance against another. Beneath all of this lay an economic cause: Sparta's finances had long rested on allied tribute and on the grain trade of the Black Sea, and once war began, tribute stopped flowing and the wartime tax was levied, which brought the quarrels inside the alliance over distribution and burden out into the open.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接後果是斯巴達霸權上的裂縫。斯巴達沒能解散聯盟，進入阿提卡的軍隊無功而返，反倒令雅典確認斯巴達不可能再單方面改變希臘現狀。尼亞克索斯和約之後，雅典第二海上同盟復興，希臘人進入所謂各城邦自治的年代；底比斯則接著用聯盟的實力在陸地挑戰斯巴達，前371年留克特拉一役正是同一條路線的下一級台階。制度層面上，這場戰爭暴露了同盟軍模式的兩難：聯盟分遣隊一旦解散，盟邦便沒有義務再供應兵員；此後希臘世界反覆爭論聯軍該由哪一城出錢養另一城的兵，爭論都從這場衝突開始。技術與物資層面上，圍城戰常態化，撞槌、破城槌與海軍封鎖線同時使用，希臘火兵也在這一階段成熟，之後成為攻城方打破防禦的標準手段。東地中海大國在此證明了自己能介入希臘事務：塞浦路斯、埃及與波斯的錢和穀物，讓反斯巴達的一方得以長期支撐。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of this war was the first crack in Spartan hegemony. Sparta failed to dissolve the leagues, the army that marched into Attica went home having achieved nothing, and Athens was left confirmed in the view that Sparta could no longer reshape Greece on its own. After the Peace of Naxos the Second Athenian League was revived and the Greeks entered the era of the autonomy of the cities, while Thebes, using the resources of the league, took up the challenge to Sparta on land, the next step on that road being Leuctra in 371 BC. At the level of institutions the war exposed the dilemma of the federal army: once the contingents are dissolved, the member cities owe nothing further, and every later argument in the Greek world about which city should pay to maintain another city's soldiers starts from this conflict. At the level of technique and supply, siege warfare became normal, with battering rams, stone-throwing engines and naval blockade used together, and Greek fire matured during this period into the standard means by which a besieger broke a defence. The great powers of the eastern Mediterranean also demonstrated here that they could intervene in Greek affairs, since the money and grain of Cyprus, Egypt and Persia allowed the anti-Spartan side to keep going over the long term.
result: 公元前378年的軍事結果是斯巴達沒有做到想做的事：維奧蒂亞聯盟照常運作，克里奧布羅圖斯一世的入侵無功而返，底比斯守住了山口，斐里堡沒有淪陷，雅典也沒有被攻破；斯巴達在海陸兩線都失去主動。海權方面的逆轉更為徹底：公元前376年九月的尼亞克索斯海戰之後，斯巴達放棄制海，和約確認斯巴達放棄希臘霸主地位，希臘人獲得各城自治的空間，雅典第二海上同盟重新成立，維奧蒂亞聯盟也成為前四世紀末陸權政治的中心。戰爭的長期走向則是斯巴達由盛轉衰：在庫羅科斯原野之後，斯巴達被福基斯使節的演說說服，出手對付底比斯，等於親手把同盟內部的矛盾推到前面，於是先後出現前371年的第一次起義與前362年的第二次起義，最終前338年喀羅戰役之後希臘舊秩序解體。這場戰爭本身沒有什麼轟動一時的會戰，卻是斯巴達的和平崩壞時傳出的第一聲裂響。
resultEn: The military outcome of 378 BC was that Sparta did not achieve what it wanted. The Boeotian League carried on as before, the invasion under Cleombrotus I ended without result, the Thebans held the passes, Phyle did not fall, and Athens was not taken; Sparta lost the initiative on both land and sea. The reversal at sea was the more complete: after the naval action off Naxos in September 376 BC, Sparta gave up command of the sea, the peace settlement confirmed the end of Spartan leadership in Greece, the Greeks gained room for the autonomy of their cities, the Second Athenian League was reconstituted, and the Boeotian League became the centre of land power in the late fourth century. The long trajectory runs from here to the decline of Sparta: after the Crocus Field the Spartans were moved by the speech of the Phocian envoys to take on Thebes, which brought the friction inside the alliance to the front, and produced in turn the revolt of 371 BC and the second revolt of 362 BC, and finally the dissolution of the old Greek order after Chaeronea in 338 BC. This war had no spectacular battle to its name, but it was the first crack running through the so-called Peace of Sparta.
